user.title: Add PiPup device
user.description: Connect to a TV running the PiPup fork (see the integration documentation).

data_description.name_suffix: Appended to all entity names of this device (e.g. "Veranda" gives "Popup Veranda") so multiple TVs stay distinguishable in pickers.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to PiPup on this host/port
error.unsupported_version: This device runs the original PiPup without /state support; install the fork APK first

abort.already_configured: This PiPup device is already configured
abort.address_mismatch: The device at this address reports a different PiPup id. Android TVs share generic mDNS hostnames (Android.local), so a discovered service can resolve to another TV's address — ignoring this announcement rather than pointing the entry at the wrong TV.

data.scan_interval: Polling interval (seconds; not used when the app pushes)
data.update_source: App update source: github:owner/repo, a folder URL with releases.json (LAN mirror), or off
data.default_sound: Default notification sound ("default" = built-in chime, or a URL; empty = none)
data.default_dismiss_screensaver: End the screensaver before showing a popup (default)
data.default_button_size: Default button text size (sp; 0 = classic look)
data.default_stack: Default stacking of popups at the same position
data.default_video_decoder: Video decoder for video and camera streams (auto, hardware, software)
data.default_title_color: Default title color (#RRGGBB, empty = app default)
data.default_message_color: Default message color (#RRGGBB, empty = app default)
data.default_background_color: Default background color (#AARRGGBB, empty = app default)
data.default_border_width: Default border width in px (empty = none)
data.default_corner_radius: Default corner radius in px (empty = none)
data.default_icon_width: Default icon width in px (empty/0 = app default)
data.overlay_pages: Overlay pages, one per line: Name | URL

data_description.name_suffix: Appended to all entity names of this device (e.g. "Veranda" gives "Popup Veranda") so multiple TVs stay distinguishable in pickers.
data_description.overlay_pages: Every overlay's Page select offers these, plus Custom URL. Example: Agenda | http://192.168.1.10:8123/local/agenda.html
data_description.parent_device: The TV this PiPup app runs on; the PiPup device is shown under it. Empty: found automatically from the Android TV integrations (remote first, then ADB) on the same IP address.
data_description.default_video_decoder: Auto lets the app decide (hardware; software on Android < 8 and on Amlogic). Software for a TV that freezes or stutters on video popups, e.g. while Live TV holds the hardware decoder. The Software decoder field of pipup.show overrides it per popup. App 0.17.2 or newer.

advanced_install.name: Advanced install
advanced_install.description: How the PiPup app is updated. On Android < 12 the TV asks for a remote press on a self-update; a built-in ADB install (like install.sh) does not. Needs network debugging (ADB) on the TV. Media session access and the click list are set over ADB as well.

data.click_packages: Apps PiPup may press buttons in

data_description.install_method: App self-update: as before; on Android < 12 the TV asks for a press of OK. Auto: the app's own update on Android 12+ (silent), an ADB install on older versions. ADB: always ADB. Choosing Auto or ADB tests the connection when you save.
data_description.adb_key: PiPup's own key (.storage/pipup_adbkey), or the Android TV integration's, so a TV that already trusts it shows no new prompt.
data_description.auto_update: Install a new PiPup release by itself inside the quiet window: one TV at a time, never while a popup is on screen, and on a TV that is on the app is never opened. Success only writes a logbook entry; a failure retries the next night, with a repair after 3 failed nights (or at once when something on the TV needs fixing). Needs ADB on Android < 12.
data_description.beta_updates: Also offer and install the app's test releases (prereleases such as 0.32.0-beta.3), for trying a fix before it is released. Only with the install method ADB (or Auto where that means ADB): Home Assistant then downloads the APK itself. With automatic updates on, a TV also gets betas at night. Off: back to releases only; a TV on a beta moves on to the next release.
data_description.quiet_start: Local time. A window may cross midnight; the same start and end time = all day.
data_description.media_access: Lets PiPup read the active media session of any app (title, playing or paused, position) and seek it, for the media player. Granted over ADB when you save; it is a notification-listener grant, but PiPup reads no notifications. Android ignores it on low-RAM devices. App 0.32.0 or newer.
data_description.click_packages: Package names separated by commas, e.g. com.plexapp.android. Filled in: switches on PiPup's separate control service (an accessibility service that looks at the screen only during a click call, only in these apps, and returns nothing from it) and sets this list over ADB when you save. Empty: switches the control service off. App 0.32.0 or newer.

adb_authorize.title: Allow debugging on the TV
adb_authorize.description: The TV ({host}) now shows "Allow debugging from this computer?" (or "Allow USB debugging?"). Tick **Always allow from this computer**, choose OK, then click Submit here. If the prompt is gone, click Submit: it comes back and Home Assistant waits 30 seconds.

error.invalid_update_source: Use github:owner/repo, an http(s) folder URL with releases.json, or off.
error.adb_cannot_connect: Cannot reach ADB on the TV. Turn on network debugging (ADB) in the developer options and check the port.
error.adb_not_authorized: The TV did not allow debugging from Home Assistant.
error.adb_no_androidtv_key: The Android TV integration's ADB key does not exist. Choose the own key.
error.adb_key_unreadable: The ADB key file (or its .pub) cannot be read. Choose the other key, or remove the damaged file from .storage.
error.auto_update_needs_adb: On this TV the app's own update needs a press on the remote, so automatic updates need the install method Auto or ADB.
error.beta_needs_adb: Beta versions need the install method ADB (or Auto where that means ADB) on this TV: the app's own update only knows releases.
error.invalid_click_packages: Use package names separated by commas, e.g. com.plexapp.android,com.google.android.youtube.tv.
error.media_click_needs_app: Media session access and clicking need PiPup app 0.32.0 or newer on this TV.
error.adb_grant_failed: ADB connected, but the TV did not accept the change. The log has the TV's answer.

options.stream: Live stream (HLS — can freeze live TV)

options.auto: Auto: app on Android 12+, ADB below

show.name: Show popup
show.description: Shows a popup on the targeted PiPup device(s). Duration 0 keeps it visible until dismissed.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to show the popup; 0 = until dismissed or replaced. When omitted, the device default (integration settings) is used.

popup_id.name: Popup ID
popup_id.description: Identifier: re-sending the same ID and content only extends the timer (no flicker); dismiss can target this ID.

position.name: Position
position.description: Corner or center of the screen. When omitted, the device's configured default position (select entity) is used.

camera_entity.name: Camera
camera_entity.description: Camera entity to show; overrides the media URLs.

camera_mode.name: Camera mode
camera_mode.description: How the camera is shown. MJPEG (default) is software-decoded and audio-free — safe while the TV plays video. HLS uses a hardware decoder and can freeze concurrent playback on some TVs.

video_url.name: Video URL
video_url.description: Video to play (HLS/MP4/RTSP support depends on the TV).

buffer_ms.name: Video buffer
buffer_ms.description: Video URL and camera streams only: start playing once this many milliseconds are buffered, and stay that close to live. An RTSP stream then runs about 1 s behind the camera instead of 3–4 s (150–300 is a good start for talk-back). Meant for RTSP; app 0.31.0 or newer, older apps ignore it.

software_decoder.name: Software decoder
software_decoder.description: Video URL and camera streams (stream mode) only: on = decode in software, off = the TV's hardware decoder, for this popup. Leave it out to use the TV's Video decoder option. Software decoding helps a TV whose hardware decoder is busy (Live TV in the background) or freezes; it costs more CPU. App 0.17.2 or newer.

web_url.name: Web URL
web_url.description: Web page to render (JavaScript and autoplay enabled).

whep_url.name: WHEP URL
whep_url.description: WebRTC stream played straight from a WHEP endpoint, for example go2rtc's /api/webrtc?src=camera on port 1984. Starts faster and steadier than go2rtc's player page in web_url (app 0.25.0 or newer).

media_height.name: Media height
media_height.description: Media height in pixels: the web/WHEP view height (default 360), and for a camera or video popup the box height until the stream reports its own shape, so an anamorphic camera snapshot shows correctly; older apps ignore it.

muted.name: Mute audio
muted.description: Mutes audio in video/web streams. When omitted, the device default applies (integration settings; audio can freeze video on some TVs).

media_full_bleed.name: Full-bleed media
media_full_bleed.description: Run the video or image edge to edge across the top of the popup, its top corners rounded with the popup; title, message and buttons keep the padding. Older apps ignore it.

buttons_inline.name: Inline buttons
buttons_inline.description: Put the buttons at the end of the title/message row instead of on their own row below it, e.g. a single compact ✕. Older apps ignore it.

tts.name: Speak text
tts.description: Text spoken aloud on the TV when the popup appears (app 0.2.5 or newer).

tts_language.name: Speech language
tts_language.description: BCP-47 language tag for the spoken text (e.g. nl-NL); device default when omitted.

urgency.name: Urgency
urgency.description: Styling preset: colored border by severity (app 0.3.0 or newer).

border_color.name: Border color
border_color.description: Border color as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. Overrides the urgency preset's color.

border_width.name: Border width
border_width.description: Border thickness in pixels. 0 removes the border, also the urgency preset's one.

corner_radius.name: Corner radius
corner_radius.description: Rounded corners in pixels. Works without a border too; 0 keeps them square.

show_progress.name: Show countdown bar
show_progress.description: Animated bar showing the remaining duration (finite durations only; app 0.3.0 or newer).

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Up to 3 buttons operated with the TV remote (OK selects, BACK dismisses). A list of objects with an id and a label; a press fires the pipup_button event in Home Assistant and closes the popup. App 0.3.0 or newer.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Optional icon (image URL) shown beside the title/message.

icon_position.name: Icon position
icon_position.description: Show the icon on the left (default) or right of the text.

poster_url.name: Poster image
poster_url.description: Still image (URL) shown over a video/web stream until its first frame renders — e.g. a camera snapshot — so the popup never opens empty. Requires app 0.17.0+; a camera_entity popup gets its own snapshot automatically.

poster_mode.name: Poster fit
poster_mode.description: How the poster fills the media area, without changing the area's size: Fit (the whole image, bars where it does not fill), Fill (cropped to fill), Stretch, or Center (original size). Leave it out to let the poster give the area its shape, as before. Video, web and WHEP popups; app 0.32.0-beta.4 or newer, older apps ignore it.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: "default" plays the built-in chime, or give a URL to an audio clip. Played once when the popup is newly shown, not on an update-in-place (app 0.18.0 or newer).

dismiss_screensaver.name: End screensaver
dismiss_screensaver.description: End an active screensaver / ambient mode before showing the popup, so it is visible on every Android version. Off keeps the screensaver (app 0.18.0 or newer).

button_size.name: Button size
button_size.description: Button text size in sp; padding scales along, so popups with buttons can be small (app 0.19.0 or newer). Omit for the classic look.

button_color.name: Button color
button_color.description: Fill of an unfocused button as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; older apps ignore it. Omit for the classic look.

button_focus_color.name: Button focus color
button_focus_color.description: Fill of the focused button as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; older apps ignore it. Omit for the classic blue.

button_text_color.name: Button text color
button_text_color.description: Button label color as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; older apps ignore it. Omit for white.

button_border_color.name: Button border color
button_border_color.description: Button outline color, focused and unfocused, as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; older apps ignore it.

button_corner_radius.name: Button corner radius
button_corner_radius.description: Button corner radius in pixels; 0 gives square corners, a large value a pill. Older apps ignore it.

animation.name: Animation
animation.description: Entrance animation, reversed when the popup expires naturally. An update-in-place of the same popup does not re-animate (app 0.19.0 or newer).

stack.name: Stack
stack.description: Line up with the other stacking popups at the same position instead of overlapping them: vertical (away from the top or bottom edge) or horizontal (away from the left or right edge). The rest moves up when one closes. Not for center (app 0.27.0 or newer; an older app ignores it).

padding.name: Padding
padding.description: Outer margin of the popup around its content in px; 20 is the classic look, 0 near-borderless (app 0.19.1 or newer).

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: Whole popup opacity, 0 to 1; the TV shows through below 1 (app 0.24.0 or newer).

transparent.name: Transparent page
transparent.description: web_url only: the page gets no background of its own, so a page with a transparent body shows the TV behind it (app 0.24.0 or newer).

bring_to_front.name: Redraw on top
bring_to_front.description: Only when a popup with this ID is already on the TV: draw the new one on top of the other popups instead of in its old place (app 0.24.0 or newer).

live_badge.name: Live badge
live_badge.description: Show a Live pill over a camera or video popup once the stream is playing (never over the still); older apps ignore it.

live_badge_color.name: Live badge color
live_badge_color.description: Live pill color as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; default amber.

live_badge_position.name: Live badge position
live_badge_position.description: Corner of the video for the Live pill; default bottom right.

grid.name: Camera wall
grid.description: Up to 9 WHEP streams in one popup (app 0.29.0 or newer): a list of WHEP URLs, or of mappings with whep_url, label and poster_url. All from the same server. media_width/media_height size the whole grid.

grid_columns.name: Grid columns
grid_columns.description: Number of columns. Empty = automatic (2 for up to 4 tiles, 3 above).

grid_fullscreen.name: Grid full screen
grid_fullscreen.description: Fill the screen with the camera wall. Without an explicit position or padding the popup is centred and edge to edge.

fullscreen.name: Full screen
fullscreen.description: Cover the whole screen, status and navigation bars included, with the popup centred (app 0.29.1 or newer). Matters on devices with system bars (tablets, intercom panels); on a TV it looks the same. For a frameless page give padding 0 and border width 0.

dismiss.name: Dismiss popup
dismiss.description: Removes a popup on the targeted PiPup device(s): the one with the given ID, else the one shown without an ID. With app 0.24.0 or newer several popups can be up at once.

popup_id.name: Popup ID
popup_id.description: Remove the popup with this ID. Leave empty to remove the popup shown without an ID.

all.name: All popups
all.description: Remove every popup on the TV (app 0.24.0 or newer).

fix_permission.name: Fix permission
fix_permission.description: Puts a permission screen on the TV so it can be granted with the remote. The app cannot grant these itself; where a device has no such screen it shows the adb command instead.

permission.name: Permission
permission.description: Which screen to open: the app's own overview, the first missing permission, or a specific one.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Reads the state of the targeted PiPup device(s) now and re-sends the push webhook to the app.

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Starts an app on the TV, or opens a deep link (app 0.29.0 or newer). A sleeping screen is woken first.

package.name: Package
package.description: Android package name, e.g. com.netflix.ninja. The media player's source list shows the installed apps.

uri.name: Link
uri.description: Deep link to open, e.g. a YouTube URL. With a package as well, only that app opens it.

wake.name: Wake the screen
wake.description: Turn a sleeping screen on first.

click.name: Press view
click.description: App 0.32.0 or newer: once the app is open, press this view (resource ID or Compose test tag, e.g. action-button-watch). The app has to be on the TV's click list (options, Advanced install).

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: How long to wait for the view, in seconds (0-30; 10 when Press view is set and this is empty). Up to 15 with apps older than 0.32.0-beta.2.

method.name: How to press
method.description: Click (an accessibility click, the default), Tap (a touch on the centre of the view, app 0.32.0-beta.2 or newer; only on devices with touch input) or OK (app 0.32.0-beta.3: focus the view and press OK, like the remote; below Android 13 Home Assistant presses OK over ADB). Use OK for apps that ignore the click, such as Plex.

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Sends a media key to the app that is playing, or home/back (those need the accessibility service). App 0.29.0 or newer.

click.name: Press button in app
click.description: Presses a view in an app on the TV by its resource ID or Compose test tag (app 0.32.0 or newer). Only for apps on the TV's click list (options, Advanced install). PiPup's control service looks at the screen only during this call and returns nothing from it.

package.name: Package
package.description: The app the view belongs to; it has to be in front.

id.name: View ID
id.description: Resource ID (com.plexapp.android:id/name, or just name) or Compose test tag, e.g. action-button-watch. `uiautomator dump` lists them as resource-id.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the view to appear (0-30; up to 15 with apps older than 0.32.0-beta.2).

method.name: How to press
method.description: App 0.32.0-beta.2 or newer: Click (an accessibility click, the default), Tap (a touch on the centre of the view; only on devices with touch input, Android 11+ TVs usually have none) or OK (app 0.32.0-beta.3: focus the view and press OK, like the remote; below Android 13 Home Assistant presses OK over ADB). Use OK for apps that ignore the click, such as Plex.

seek.name: Seek
seek.description: Jumps to a position in what is playing, or by an offset (app 0.32.0 or newer, with media session access).

position.name: Position
position.description: Position in seconds from the start.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Seconds forward (positive) or back (negative) from the current position.

package.name: Package
package.description: Seek this app's media session instead of the active one.

no_overlay_permission.title: PiPup {name} misses the overlay permission
no_overlay_permission.description:
PiPup on {name} ({host}) does not have the SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW app-op, so it accepts every popup but shows nothing on the TV. An app cannot grant this to itself and every reinstall resets it. Grant it over adb:

`adb shell appops set nl.rogro82.pipup SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow`

or re-run the installer script from the PiPup release. This message disappears by itself once the device reports the permission.

confirm.title: Show the permission screen on the TV
confirm.description: Press Submit and PiPup opens the overlay permission screen on {name}. Switch to the TV and turn the permission on with the remote — Home Assistant cannot do that part; it is a system screen.\n\nThe warning disappears by itself once the TV reports the permission.

abort.use_adb: This TV has no screen for that permission (Fire TV, for instance, answers with a placeholder that does nothing). Grant it over adb instead:\n\n`adb shell appops set nl.rogro82.pipup SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow`
abort.cannot_connect: The TV did not answer. Try again when it is reachable.
abort.not_loaded: This PiPup device is not loaded right now.

auto_update_failed.title: Automatic PiPup update on {name} failed
auto_update_failed.description:
The automatic update of the PiPup app on {name} failed ({failures}× in a row): {reason}.

It is retried every night. Fix the cause (see the integration's options, Advanced install), or press Install on the update entity to try now. This message disappears after the next successful update.

user.title: Add an overlay
user.description: A web page pinned over the TV picture, with its own switch and settings. Pages come from the list in this TV's Configure form.

error.invalid_overlay_name: Use at least one letter or digit.
